conclusions.ixgbe_parameter: Actual loadable ixgbe.ko has allow_unsupported_sfp array-of-int parser, max33, permission0; four values are board-indexed, not all NIC families/ports. No parameter injected.
conclusions.ixgbe_vendor_branch: Actual SFP generic identification vendor-check tail warns and returns along success path without testing allow flag; other module type and EEPROM failure branches remain. Does not prove all modules accepted.
conclusions.boot_delivery: No ixgbe built-in parameter in decoded kernel __param. Custom moduler calls finit_module with string arguments; no traced boot-cmdline-to-ixgbe argument delivery. Boot append not approved by evidence.
conclusions.eeprom: Actual helper code and table references support several family module-read paths; table slots 0x160/0x168 candidate module-info/eeprom verified by behavior, but no complete vendor ABI/source available. igb slots are zero in selected table.
conclusions.userland: net has actual SIOCETHTOOL wrapper call sites; no completed dataflow for GMODULEINFO/GMODULEEEPROM to native monitor/DDM. No ethtool-named executable found. Negative strings are not absence proof.
conclusions.patch_decision: No firmware patch justified now. Parameter injection is not a demonstrated fix, especially for telemetry. Need identified failing hardware pair and traced loader or userland path before targeted design.
